title: Count heads and quadratic storage
promptMarkdown: A standard multihead attention layer has model width 64,8 heads each of key/value width 8, with Q, K, V and output projections all using biases. Count projection parameters, excluding normalisation and feed-forward layers. At batch 2, length 2048, compute the size in elements/bytes/MiB of one float32 per-head score tensor. Repeat memory for length 4096. Explain why the number is neither the full model memory nor a universal minimum for every attention implementation.
hintLadder: All heads together project to width 64 in this convention.
The tensor axes arebatch, head, query, key.
Separate mathematical operation count from stored intermediate memory.
